description: This class contains helper methods for converting between domain and entity models related to banking operations, such as Customer, Account, Address, Contact, BankInfo, Transaction, and Transfer details.

classes.name: BankingServiceHelper
classes.description: A Spring component providing utility methods for converting between domain and entity representations of bank-related data.

methods.name: convertToCustomerDomain
methods.description: Converts a Customer entity to CustomerDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToCustomerEntity
methods.description: Converts a CustomerDetails domain object to Customer entity.

methods.name: convertToAccountDomain
methods.description: Converts an Account entity to AccountInformation domain object.

methods.name: convertToAccountEntity
methods.description: Converts an AccountInformation domain object to Account entity.

methods.name: convertToAddressDomain
methods.description: Converts an Address entity to AddressDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToAddressEntity
methods.description: Converts an AddressDetails domain object to Address entity.

methods.name: convertToContactDomain
methods.description: Converts a Contact entity to ContactDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToContactEntity
methods.description: Converts a ContactDetails domain object to Contact entity.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoDomain
methods.description: Converts a BankInfo entity to BankInformation domain object.

methods.name: convertToBankInfoEntity
methods.description: Converts a BankInformation domain object to BankInfo entity.

methods.name: convertToTransactionDomain
methods.description: Converts a Transaction entity to TransactionDetails domain object.

methods.name: convertToTransactionEntity
methods.description: Converts a TransactionDetails domain object to Transaction entity.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Creates a Transaction object based on transfer details, account number, and transaction type.
